About

About this directory

VHS Near Me is an independent directory of digitizing services. It is not a transfer lab, and it does not take possession of anyone’s tapes or photos.

How a listing gets here

A person checks the business’s own website, writes down only what that page says, and saves it in a data file. The build script turns those files into the pages on this site. The source link stays on the listing so you can see the same page.

If the business does not publish a price, the listing says “Call for pricing.” If it does not publish a turnaround time, the listing says that too. This site does not invent businesses, review scores, star ratings, or prices.

The first version was not a personal visit to each shop. Hours and prices change. Treat every figure as a starting point dated on the page, then confirm it with the business before you leave your media there.

Affiliate disclosure

Some outbound links may later earn a commission. The partners set up for that are ScanMyPhotos, Legacybox, and iMemories. Their entries live in data/affiliates.json.

Right now each affiliate_id is empty. While it is empty, the visit link on the mail-in page is the company’s ordinary URL. There is no affiliate code and no paid placement. When a public affiliate or publisher ID is added, along with the query-parameter name that network uses, the build script appends it to that visit link and marks the link sponsored. Source citations stay plain, so the page linked as a source is the page the fact came from. A commission, if one is ever paid, does not change the price you pay the company.

Listings are not ordered by who might pay. City pages are local businesses with no affiliate relationship in this version. Mail-in companies are grouped by how they charge (per item, by the kit, or as a photo lab), which is stated on that page. Nobody paid for a slot.

Do not put API secrets, passwords, or private tokens in the repository. An affiliate ID is a public tracking code. It belongs in data/affiliates.json only after you intend the live site to use it. .gitignore already ignores .env and .env.* files.

What this site does not do

There is no account, no checkout, and no upload. There are no third-party analytics, advertising pixels, or web fonts. Pages are static HTML and CSS served from the repository.

Corrections are edits to the data files. The recipe for a new city page is in CONTRIBUTING.md. A wrong price should be fixed by re-reading the source page, not by guessing a better number.

VHS Near Me is an independent directory. It does not convert tapes, scan photos, or handle your originals.
